text:
The plate is square, about 340 px wide in the image. If it is a dinner plate of roughly 26 cm, that works out to about 13 px per cm.

Each corn piece is about 100 px across, so roughly 7-8 cm in diameter. That makes them two cob segments, each about 3-4 cm thick.

A corn cob segment of that size weighs about 80-100 g with the cob. Two segments come to roughly 180 g.

Corn on the cob runs about 90 kcal per 100 g, counting only the kernels and the cob weight together. That gives about 110-130 kcal for the two pieces.
